caveats: Hosts: macOS 14+, Linux on X11 or Wayland (tested on GNOME), or Windows 10/11 (experimental); any Paseo client can view.
Enable plugins on the host; the helper builds on first use (Xcode tools on macOS, a C compiler and dev packages on Linux).
To allow control, grant Paseo Screen Recording and Accessibility on macOS and reopen it; on Wayland, approve the sharing dialog.
A locked host can be unlocked by typing your password, except GNOME on Wayland, which stops sharing until unlocked at the machine.
Windows can't show or control the lock, sign-in or UAC screens, and apps running as administrator ignore remote input.
Any paired client can see and control the host; Pause remote control stops input. Keep the host from sleeping, or it goes offline.
